mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine increases sympathomimetic activity and blood pressure, while eplerenone (a selective aldosterone antagonist) causes potassium retention and can lead to hyperkalemia, with stimulants increasing cardiovascular stress.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and serum potassium levels regularly; counsel patient on sodium restriction and signs of hyperkalemia; consider alternative ADHD agent if significant hypertension develops.
